name: running_total
title: Running total
description: Adds the column running_total: the sum of amount over this row and every row before it, with rows sorted by sorted_by. Empty amounts add nothing.
author: ParVu

params.name: sorted_by
params.description: The order of the rows (a date, an id…)

body.source:
SELECT *,
  sum(amount) OVER (ORDER BY sorted_by ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
FROM t
ORDER BY sorted_by
